title: Algebraic Structure of Quantum Controlled States and Operators
summary: Quantum control is an important logical primitive of quantum computing programs, and an important concept for equational reasoning in quantum graphical calculi. We show that controlled diagrams in the ZXW-calculus admit rich algebraic structure. The perspective of the higher-order map Ctrl recovers the standard notion of quantum controlled gates, while respecting sequential and parallel composition and multiple-control.
